description:
Xxarra's Variety Pack
By Xxarra

(Requires MagicLib 1.5.6)
(Requires GraphicsLib 1.12.1)
(Requires LazyLib v3.0)

- Supports Nexerelin -

(NOT save compatible with previous versions, or with existing saves.)

Mod adds 60+ new ships, exploration and quest content, custom starts, multiple unique bounties, and additions to existing Vanilla content.

All sprites in this mod are free to use for bashing without asking or permission, on 3 conditions: It must be for a Starsector mod, that mod must have a similarly permissive license, and credit is provided. They cannot, however, be used one-for-one without editing.

NEON's ship pack

-Version 1.0 - (release!)

-Version 1.1 - Sisyhpus Shield Hotfix

-Version 1.2 - Messenger Temporary Description added, Incorrect id for the Blockhead corrected

-Version 1.3 -  Infinite Burst Drive fixed (should be save compatible)

-Version 1.4 -  Reduced Grox OP from 80 to 60, adjusted Grox and Anger spawn rates (should be save compatible)

-Version 1.5 - Adjusted spawn rates of Hammonitor, Anger, Shrisse, Messenger, Regal and Legate class vessels, fixed crash from the Sisyphus' system no longer existing (should be save compatible)

-Version 1.6 - Incorrect id for the blockhead ACTUALLY corrected this time (should be save compatible)

-Version 1.7 - Added line break in Anger ship description, fixed incompatibility with Nexerilin's randomized sector

-Version 1.8 - Adjusted spawn weights of Anger, Shrisse, Messenger and Regal class vessels

-Version 1.9 - Removed Anger and Grox class vessels from the priority ships of the pirates, adjusted spawn weights of Anger, Grox, Regal and Messenger class vessels

-Version 2.0 - Adjusted spawn weights across the board, added new sprites for Thgualsno, Legate, Shrisse, Varanus, and Sisyphus class ships. Adjusted ship stats across the board. Added new custom fleet to the Limbo system. Added Hermod, Trinarch, Phosphophyllite, Phosphoresence, Phite, Pitbull, Wolf (H) II, Medusa (LT), St. Bernard, Explorator, Goblin, Mace, Domination and Ajax class ships.

-Version 2.1 - Added improved sprite for the Trinarch class, modified the custom fleet in the Limbo system, added the Luminance class frigate to the Derelict faction, adjusted the Domination class' standard variant

-Version 2.2 - Added descriptions for the Luminance, Blockhead, Phosphoresence and Medusa (LT) class vessels. Added description for the deepstrike ship system. Fixed descriptions for existing derelict vessels. Fixed a mount on the Shrisse class.

-Version 2.3 - Added new sprite for the Invictus (XIV), fixed Absolution class description, added built-in weapon Herald Defense Cannon to Messenger and Templar class vessels, removed Advanced Targeting Core from Messenger class, reduced Messenger OP to 130 from 150, changed Invictus (XIV) OP to 380 from 240 to allow usage of new mount layout, added Improved Ablative Armor hullmod.

-Version 2.4 - Adjusted spawnweights, fixed Invictus (XIV) not spawning in it's own fleet, adjusted DP of Goblin class to 16 from 18, added Hobgoblin class phase destroyer, fixed Mace class standard variant

-Version 2.5 - Added Reprieve class heavy cruiser, adjusted Hobgoblin OP from 140 to 120

-Version 2.6 - Added Fighter, Gun, and Bomber platform fighter wings, added Rampart (C), Siegecarrier class ships. Adjusted OP of Templar class Dreadnought and Trinarch class vessels to allow the usage of the new fighters, adjusted Trinarch class' DP from 50 to 65. Adjusted sprite for the Trinarch class.

-Version 2.6.1 - Added Hammerhead (TT) class destroyer.

-Version 2.6.2 - Added improved sprite for Trinarch class, adjusted sprite and standard variant for the Templar class, increased Pitbull class' DP from 8 to 13.

-Version 2.6.9 - Added Nemetor class drone battleship to the derelict faction, reduced number of bays in Rampart (C) and Siegecarrier class vessels to 2 and 4 bays respectively. Reduced OP of Rampart (C) and Siegecarrier class vessels to 130 and 180 respectively.

-Version 2.7 - Added Pursuit Platform, Carrier Platform, and Bulwark class vessels to the derelict faction. Changed Bomber Platform wing to have two hammer torpedo (single)s instead of two atropos (double) missiles, lowered Bomber Platform wing's HP and Armor values. Increased Domination class' DP to 28 from 25.

-Version 2.7.1 - Adjusted Nemetor class' peak performance time to 90 seconds from 2000, adjusted Trinarch class' peak performance time to 150 from 820. Implemented new sprite for the Nemetor class.

-Version 2.7.2 - Added Konoblin class phase destroyer.

-Version 2.7.3 - Implemented name and description for the Nemetor and Domination class vessels' built-in weapon, now named the Material Obliterator.

-Version 2.7.4 - 0.98a-RC6 release.

-Version 3.0.0
>Implemented new sprites for Templar, Praxidike, and Hammerhead (TT) class vessels. Added built-in d-mods to Thgualsno class battleship.
>Rebalanced ships across the board with changes to OP pools, spawn weights, and stats.
>Reduced armor effectiveness of the Improved Ablative Armor hullmod from 50% to 30%, and reduced the armor of the Invictus (XIV) to 5000 from 10000. >Reduced OP of Invictus (XIV) to 310 from 380, increased DP to 85 from 70, and increased it's fuel consumption from 20 to 23 fuel per light year. Added Legion and Dominator Mk.1 hulls, along with short quests to go with them.
>Added Absolution (PR), Onnslaught (PR), Legion (PR) and Dominator (PR) class vessels.
>Removed Heavy Composite Integration from Nemetor class, alongside rebalances to it's stats.
>Changed Taskforce Safeguard to be within the ship_data.csv file instead of .skin files, to solve issue with codex.
>Added Energy Bolt Coherer hullmod to Falcon (XIV-A) class.
>Increased DP of Templar class dreadnought to 120 from 90.
>Reduced armor rating of Trinarch class battlecarrier to 1000 from 1300.
>Changed number of fighters in Fighter Platform LPC to 5 from 6, replaced wing's light machine guns with vulcans.

-Version 3.0.1 - Hotfixes for minor issues like modules being selectable, and misaligned weapon mounts. Should be save compatible with 3.0.0

-Version 3.0.2 - Implemented Iliad and Culmination class vessels, implemented new sprites for the Grox/Goblin Mk.II, Luminance, and Legate class vessels. Fixed bug where (PR) style hull modules counted alongside the base DP of the hull. Added tips. Adjusted some stats.

-Version 3.0.3 - Implemented Incursor, Dominator (LP), and Hammerhead (LP) class vessels. Removed missile autoforge, advanced targeting core from Nemetor and Templar class ships. Nerfed stat spread of the Templar class. Removed Thegualsno class reversed Onslaught battleship. Implemented new sprite and ship system for the Nemetor class, implemented new sprite for the Regal class cruiser.

-Version 3.0.4 - Implemented Gleam, Intus class ships. Implemented re-sprites and re-balances for Shrisse and Hermod class ships. Re-added Thgualsno to the files, but not the faction spawning pool. Implemented improved sprite for the Domination class, implemented new fire sound for the Material Obliterator.

-Version 3.0.5 - Implemented Rampage Bounty.

-Version 3.0.5.1 - Increased range of Adjutant Defense Cannon to 900 from 500. Implemented improved sprite for the Shrisse class.

-Version 3.0.5.2 - Implemented Rising Phoenix Bounty.

-Version 3.0.5.3 - Implemented Elucidation class, Dominator (M), and accompanying bounties. Fixed Dominator (LP) and Hammerhead (LP) class ships not spawning in Luddic Path fleets. Re-added Thgualsno class reversed battleship as a unique bounty ship.

-Version 3.0.5.4 - Implemented Vigil star system in the bottom left of the sector, implemented Recluse class, Avant-garde class vessels. Adjusted stats of the Rampager class.

-Version 3.0.5.5 - Hotfix for Recluse variant causing crash thanks to hullmod from SoTF

-Version 3.0.5.6 - Implemented new sprite for the Praxidike class, implemented Praxidike Mk.II class. Not save compatible.

-Version 3.0.5.7 - Fixed Built-in Cardinal wing spawning in Derelict fleets and non-derelict fleets. Implemented new sprite and stats for the St. Bernard class. Should be save compatible with previous version

-Version 3.0.5.8 - Turned XIV Invictus' transponder on. Implemented new sprites for Hammerhead (LP), Hammerhead (TT), and Varanus class ships. Implemented Eagle (TT) and Falcon (TT) class ships.

RENAME TO XXARRA'S VARIETY PACK - 8/1/2026

-Version 0.1a, Initial release:
- Removed all Derelict Explorarium content and seperated it out into it's own in-development mod.
- Removed Phosphoresence Remnant Onslaught and Legate class ships.
- Added Balaam class converted Invictus, Nebula Mk.II class, Dachshund class civilian freighter, Bullshark class battlecarrier, Scintillation class Remnant battlecarrier, Phosphoresence class Remnant battlecarrier, Culmination class Exploration battlecruiser (the star trek looking ship), Dominator Mk.III, Eagle Mk. III, Champion Mk.III, Eagle (LP), Onslaught (LP), Absolution (LP), Cassowary class battlecarrier, Peregrine class battleship, Apogee (C), Apogee (C) (LG), Cassowary (A), Champion (A), Falcon (A), Hammerhead (A), Centurion (A) and Brawler (A).
- Added a Luddic Church quest and related ship, the Exponent.
- Added Nexerilin Custom start "Contact" that grants the player the ability to use and recover Threat type hulls in a similar manner to Automated Ships.
- Added Nexerilin Custom Start "Ancients" which grants the player the Fulgurite, Erebid and Kardakes class ships.
- Reworked and overhauled the automation style of the Mk.1 ships including the Onslaught Mk.1 to grant them better balance and more flavor. These changes also apply to the Taskforce Safeguard automated XIV hulls.
- The Mk.1 Legion, Mk.1 Dominator, Dominator (LP)/Dominator Mk.III, Ajax, Wolf (H), Goblin, Praxidike and Praxidike Mk.II class ships have been given new spritework.
- Re-balanced several ships and attempted to bring balance closer to vanilla overall.
- Fixed MagicLib Bounties not showing locations correctly (or at least attempted to).

-Version 0.1a.1 - Fixed Decorum class not spawning in any faction fleets/being unknown to factions

-Version 0.1a.2 - Added Retribution (LP) class
- Added Blatt class Heavy Frigate
- Removed some Unused ships, Removed Phite class, Removed Hobgoblin class.
- Added custom engine loop noise to Luddic Path ships, added Vector Engines for Luddic Path ships
- Buffed Cassowary class battlecarrier slightly
- Fixed crash regarding AI switch hullmod

-Version 0.1a.3 - Increased Retribution (LP)-class' dp from 40 to 50.
- Removed Independent and Mercenary tags from the Absolution (LP)'s ship_data.csv line.
- Reworked the Incursor class somewhat, making the ship shielded, giving it a medium mount, and changing the ship system to Accelerated Ammo Feeder. It has also recieved Distributed Fire Control and the Hardened Armor hullmod, with it's armor being reduced to 250 accordingly. With these changes, it's DP has also been raised to 9, and the (LP) variant to 10.

III, Champion Mk.III, Eagle (LP), Onslaught (LP), Absolution (LP), Cassowary class battlecarrier, Peregrine class battleship, Apogee (C), Apogee (C) (LG), Cassowary (A), Champion (A), Falcon (A), Hammerhead (A), Centurion (A) and Brawler (A).
- Added a Luddic Church quest and related ship, the Exponent.
- Added Nexerilin Custom start "Contact" that grants the player the ability to use and recover Threat type hulls in a similar manner to Automated Ships.
- Added Nexerilin Custom Start "Ancients" which grants the player the Fulgurite, Erebid and Kardakes class ships.
- Reworked and overhauled the automation style of the Mk.1 ships including the Onslaught Mk.1 to grant them better balance and more flavor. These changes also apply to the Taskforce Safeguard automated XIV hulls.
- The Mk.1 Legion, Mk.1 Dominator, Dominator (LP)/Dominator Mk.III, Ajax, Wolf (H), Goblin, Praxidike and Praxidike Mk.II class ships have been given new spritework.
- Re-balanced several ships and attempted to bring balance closer to vanilla overall.
- Fixed MagicLib Bounties not showing locations correctly (or at least attempted to).

-Version 0.1a.1 - Fixed Decorum class not spawning in any faction fleets/being unknown to factions

-Version 0.1a.2 - Added Retribution (LP) class
- Added Blatt class Heavy Frigate
- Removed some Unused ships, Removed Phite class, Removed Hobgoblin class.
- Added custom engine loop noise to Luddic Path ships, added Vector Engines for Luddic Path ships
- Buffed Cassowary class battlecarrier slightly
- Fixed crash regarding AI switch hullmod

-Version 0.1a.3 - Increased Retribution (LP)-class' dp from 40 to 50.
- Removed Independent and Mercenary tags from the Absolution (LP)'s ship_data.csv line.
- Reworked the Incursor class somewhat, making the ship shielded, giving it a medium mount, and changing the ship system to Accelerated Ammo Feeder. It has also recieved Distributed Fire Control and the Hardened Armor hullmod, with it's armor being reduced to 250 accordingly. With these changes, it's DP has also been raised to 9, and the (LP) variant to 10.
